craft_notes: Sthāyin: water-wheel repetition. Rows: simile then union. Rejected: modernizing simile — killed: wheel kept. Read aloud: turning creak, still drink.

lines: But striven is spell-rise: like the water-wheel's draw,
by one-pointed tending — wondrous spell-rise plied day and night —
with the spell's goddess one-ness wins.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatnajas tu mantrodayaḥ araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhanavat ekānusaṃdhibalāt citraṃ mantrodayaṃ divāniśam anusaṃdadhat mantradevatayā saha tādātmyam eti
